blocks.text: Waterfront & Character Homes in Crescent Beach
Homes for Sale in Crescent Beach & Ocean Park, South Surrey

parts.t: Crescent Beach is a seaside village in South Surrey at the mouth of the Nicomekl River, known for its oceanfront homes, character cottages and shops along Beecher Street. Set along the shoreline with water views, a sandy beach and walking paths, it sits a short drive from everyday amenities. Buyers look here for a mix of older homes, updated properties and some waterfront homes, many just steps from the beach and local cafés. Ocean Park, on the bluff to the south, is mostly detached homes with some townhomes and condos. The two share one MLS® sub-area, so the listings below cover both. Explore all Crescent Beach Ocean Park listings below.

Common Questions · Crescent Beach & Ocean Park
Is there a benchmark price just for Crescent Beach or Ocean Park?

No. FVREB publishes benchmarks for the combined South Surrey & White Rock area only. For a local picture, see the past sales for MLS® sub-area F53 above, which cover Crescent Beach and Ocean Park together.
Is flooding a consideration in Crescent Beach?

It's worth checking. Crescent Beach is low-lying at the mouth of the Nicomekl. The City approved a Coastal Flood Adaptation Strategy in 2019. Under its Crescent Beach Utility Improvements (Phases 1–3 completed by May 2025), the City reports that about 70% of properties now have a storm sewer fronting or flanking them, and it's studying drainage options for the rest. Ask about the specific property, and check insurance before removing subjects. (
Which secondary school serves Crescent Beach and Ocean Park?
Every address I checked in Crescent Beach and western Ocean Park returned Elgin Park Secondary. An address on 140 Street returned Semiahmoo Secondary. Always check the specific address.
Are Crescent Beach and Ocean Park in the same MLS® area?
Yes. Both fall in the MLS® sub-area "Crescent Bch Ocean Pk.", which is what the listings on this page show.
Where can I walk to the beach?
The City lists Beecher, Sullivan and Target Streets as the best Crescent Beach access points. Blackie Spit Park is at 3136 McBride Avenue.
